name: Birth of Henry VIII
description: Henry VIII was born at Greenwich Palace. He was the third child of Henry VII and Elizabeth of York.

name: Ascension to the Throne
description: After the death of his father Henry VII, Henry VIII ascends to the throne.

name: Marriage to Catherine of Aragon
description: Henry VIII marries his brother's widow, Catherine of Aragon.

name: Birth of Mary
description: Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon's only surviving child, Mary, later Mary I of England, is born.

name: Affair with Anne Boleyn
description: Henry VIII begins an affair with Anne Boleyn, starting the chain of events leading to the English Reformation.

name: Break from the Catholic Church
description: Henry VIII breaks from the Catholic Church and establishes the Church of England in order to annul his marriage to Catherine of Aragon.

name: Marriage to Anne Boleyn
description: Henry VIII marries Anne Boleyn who soon gives birth to Elizabeth I.

name: Marriage to Jane Seymour
description: Henry VIII marries Jane Seymour who gives birth to his only legitimate son, Edward VI.

name: Last three marriages
description: Henry VIII goes on to marry three more times, to Anne of Cleves, Catherine Howard, and Catherine Parr.

name: Death of Henry VIII
description: Henry VIII dies at the age of 55, likely from poor health due to obesity and possibly other conditions. His son Edward VI succeeds him.
